title: rec.act
description: v0.4.1 (docs/13 §8.2, §8.4, §12.2): star, unstar, tag (assign a project; project null = none) or hide one session. cpad only appends events: no file is written, moved or deleted, manifest.json is never rewritten. project is required with tag and absent or null otherwise. Reply: ack, or error (E_UNKNOWN_ITEM, E_BAD_FIELD, E_INTERNAL; E_UNKNOWN_TYPE from an older cpad).
